summary.text: Tim Yocum is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 42, assumed office on January 16, 2025, after being appointed, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Brandi Vandivier (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Tim Yocum works in operations for Duke Energy, served as a Vermillion County Commissioner for ten years before his appointment to the Indiana House, and chairs the Vermillion County Republican Party.
Yocum succeeded Alan Morrison (R) in District 42.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Elections and Apportionment, House Environmental Affairs, and House Natural Resources committees.
